The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b1b750b309e5c5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 69. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let f : X → Y be a surjective morphism with connected fibers between smooth connected projective complex varieties. Assume κ(Y ) ≥ 0, and put d = κ(F) ≥ 0 for the geometric generic fiber F. On smooth projective models there is a factorization X′ x − → W g − → Y with connected geometric generic fibers and dim(W/Y ) = d. There are an effective SNC rational boundary B on W, a nef rational divisor M, and a morphism h0 : W → Z with connected fibers, with Z smooth projective, such that (i) KW + B + M is big over Y ; (ii) M ∼Q h∗ 0A for a nef rational divisor A on Z, and KZ + aA is big for every sufficiently large rational a; (iii) the divisible section systems of KW + B + M identify with those of KX, preserving their rational-map dimensions; (iv) the generic pair (J, DJ ) of x, with the reduced exceptional boundary inherited from X′ → X, has logarithmic Kodaira dimension zero. Its minimal-index cyclic root cover is ge- ometrically connected and has entire logarithmic top-form space of dimension one, with every positive logarithmic plurigenus at most one; (v) M is the rational parabolic extension of this entire top line, identified with the top line of the unique rational polarized pure weight grade carrying it. On an initial reduction model B is the normalized boundary of [37, Lemma 7.4]. Subsequent source models of W carry its strict transform plus reduced exceptional boundary, and the pullback of M; their section systems remain those of the original X.
